description: Deadline-driven urgency triage: opportunities that close within N days, sorted by urgency (closest deadline first), each with daysLeft until close. Unlike gov.search or gov.digest, this ignores keywords and freshness - it is purely a time-window scan for last-minute bidding, bid deadline reminders and pipeline management.

naics.description: Optional NAICS filter to narrow the window.

name: gov.near_expiry
